description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.

description.zh:
Web fallbac行为类型。

0：返回指定文本。

1：跳转到指定页面。
description.en:
The type of the web fallback behavior.

0: returns the specified content.

1: redirects to the specified page.

The encoding format.

0: normal text

1: JSON

Specifies whether to enable the throttling rule.

0: disables the throttling rule.

1: enables the throttling rule.
The unique ID of the gateway.
The HTTP text to be returned.
The address to be redirected to.
The name of the routing rule.
The overall queries per second (QPS) threshold.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse create-gateway-flow-rule --gateway-id 14407 --gateway-unique-id gw-e2d226bba4b2445c9e29fa7f82160000 --route-id 52853 --route-name routeName --threshold 10 --behavior-type 0 --body-encoding 0 --response-status-code 429 --response-content-body text --response-redirect-url www.000000.com --enable 0 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
